note: Rules correlate live bindings to S2 semantic operations by dispatcher plus optional argument digest (invariant 2: operation identity is independent of the chord). Rules matched by argument digest are environment-scoped; the native Omarchy qualification adds its own rules from the live keymap. Unmatched bindings fall through the docs/201 4.2 classification gate; exec without a digest rule is application_internal, everything else unmapped_gap (a release defect).
